ai_summary: Affle 3i Limited has allotted 1.7 million equity shares to its promoter, Affle Holdings Pte. Ltd., via a preferential allotment stemming from warrant conversion, significantly increasing the company's issued share capital. This transaction, executed at Rs. 1,115.25 per share, represents a capital infusion and consolidation of promoter ownership, with an additional USD 14.99 million worth of shares still pending allotment upon currency conversion. No red flags are apparent, as this is a standard capital-raising activity and stake adjustment involving the promoter.
